title: Split the integral
text: Split the integral at $$0$$ and use the antiderivative arctan(x).

title: Take the limits
text: arctan(x) approaches $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$ as $$x$$ goes to infinity and $$\frac{-\pi}{2}$$ as $$x$$ goes to negative $$\infty$$. So the integral is $$\frac{\pi}{2}-\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=pi$$.
